The issuer shows solid operating profitability (EBIT of 727M on revenue of 4,165M) and good near-term liquidity (current ratio ~2.2). However, retained earnings are significantly negative (-1,086M), indicating accumulated losses, and total liabilities are high relative to equity (3,366M vs. 1,634M), limiting balance-sheet strength. Overall, this supports a low investment-grade rating.

DECISION: BBB-
